definition.anchor_date: min(StartDate, StudyFirstSubmitDate) of the target trial
definition.eligible_history: other trials in the frozen snapshot with the same normalized lead sponsor, a terminal label, and outcome_public_by strictly before the target anchor_date; the target itself is never counted
definition.outcome_public_by: LastUpdatePostDate of the other trial (its final status was public no later than this date)
definition.smoothing: (stopped + 5 * p0) / (n + 5) with p0 = stop rate of the training-fit rows

promotion.rule: Existing rule: candidate is champion iff the paired ROC AUC delta (candidate - champion) 95% CI lower bound > 0 AND the candidate passes the export gate. Otherwise the current champion stays.
